saw.short: Pochettino's Man Utd debut ends in a 4-0 loss at Anfield
saw.headline: *Pochettino’s Man Utd debut* ends in a 4-0 loss at Anfield
saw.what: Liverpool beat Manchester United 4-0 on Sunday in Mauricio Pochettino’s first game in charge, per Metro. Pochettino called the early red card for Leny Yoro “unfair”, and Metro says he called the result “so painful”. Liverpool’s goals came from Szoboszlai, Wirtz, Ngumoha and Víctor Muñoz. Metro’s red-card minute varies, so we haven’t quoted one.
saw.why: The biggest football story of the weekend. Pochettino’s first game set the tone.

saw.short: England beat New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham
saw.headline: England *beat New Zealand 37-12* at Twickenham
saw.what: England beat New Zealand 37-12 at Twickenham on Saturday, a record win over the All Blacks, per BBC Sport and the Telegraph. The Telegraph says Lewis Moody joined the England team to face the haka, and captain Maro Itoje said his presence inspired the win. The Sun’s headline says 34-12, which is wrong.
saw.why: A record rugby result with a very human moment. A big shared moment for UK sport fans.

saw.short: Strictly's Blackpool show is interrupted by prank audio
saw.headline: Strictly’s *Blackpool show* is interrupted by prank audio
saw.what: Lewd audio played behind the judges during Saturday’s live Strictly show, and presenter Emma Willis apologised on air, per Radio Times and LADbible. The BBC said it is investigating and put an edited version on iPlayer. Jaime Winstone and Carlos Gu left on Sunday after a dance-off with Delta Goodrem and Kai Widdrington, per Metro.
saw.why: A live-TV glitch got more talk than the dances. Blackpool week always does well.
saw.source: Radio Times, 22 Nov; LADbible, 22 Nov; Metro, 22 Nov

saw.headline: Disney’s *Hexed* gets its London premiere ahead of UK cinemas on 27 Nov
saw.what: Disney’s Hexed held its European premiere at the Odeon Luxe, Leicester Square, on Saturday, with Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones and Jodie Foster on the red carpet, per Deadline and Film-news.co.uk. Film-news.co.uk says it opens in UK cinemas on Friday 27 Nov. We haven’t seen an official Disney UK post.
saw.why: Our client’s film week. The premiere sets up the cinema release.

saw.short: A new Home Alone film is reportedly in development
saw.headline: A new *Home Alone* film is reportedly in development with Macaulay Culkin
saw.what: Reports say Macaulay Culkin will return as Kevin McCallister in a new Home Alone film at Disney’s 20th Century Studios, with Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg attached to write and produce, per NME and LADbible. NME says no director, cast or date is announced and it is at an early stage. Neither article is an official announcement.
saw.why: A Christmas favourite returning with a Disney link. Treat as reported until confirmed.

saw.short: The Hunger Games prequel opens to $120m in North America
saw.headline: *The Hunger Games prequel* opens to $120m in North America
saw.what: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping took an estimated $120 million in North America over the opening weekend, with $105 million overseas for $225 million globally, per Variety. These are weekend estimates. Variety says it is one of only five 2026 films to open above $100 million in North America. We haven’t found a UK-specific figure.
saw.why: A big cinema weekend. Useful context for Hexed’s opening on Friday.

platform.short: TikTok's Discovery report: UK searches for padel are up 2,275%
platform.headline: TikTok’s Discovery report: *UK searches for “padel” are up 2,275%*
platform.what: TikTok’s UK newsroom published its Discovery on TikTok report on 20 Nov, covering 16–24 year olds. It says 82% use TikTok to discover new things, #SportsOnTikTok posts are up 155% globally, and UK searches for “padel” are up 2,275%. These are TikTok’s own figures.
platform.why: A source of trend ideas, with a UK sports angle. First-party data only.

platform.short: TikTok rolls out its deepfake detection tool globally
platform.headline: TikTok rolls out its *deepfake detection tool* globally for public figures
platform.what: TikTok has announced a global rollout of its likeness-detection tool for politicians and high-follower accounts, per an AP report. It was announced at TikTok’s safety event in London, ahead of European elections next year. The AP report’s original date wasn’t clear to us, and Geekout listed it on 20 Nov.
platform.why: A platform response to AI fakes. Relevant for any client with public faces.
platform.source: AP via Sunday World, 23 Nov; Geekout, 20 Nov

platform.short: Disney+ will carry TikTok creator videos from December
platform.headline: Disney+ will carry *TikTok creator videos* from December
platform.what: Disney said on 17 Nov that invite-only TikTok creator videos, made from Disney content, will appear in the vertical video feed on Disney+ in December, per Mashable. It is tied to the Avengers: Doomsday build-up. We haven’t seen a UK launch detail.
platform.why: A Disney and TikTok link worth watching for our Disney desks. US-first.
